annotations.title: Share an email-reading rule (hack) with other people

description: Shares one of the person's hacks with everyone. Community hacks belong to the community, one for each kind of email a sender sends: the hack's wording goes into the community hack for the same kind of email when that keeps everything it reads the same (so every copy takes it), or starts a new one (status added, changed or same). It's set aside, with the reason, when it would read the community hack's emails another way; and it waits (status waiting, with words) when its fixed text has a name or number no one else's hack for these emails has, until someone else's does. The person's own hack never changes. Share it again after a fix so copies can take it. Leave out examples and TrackerHacker makes them up from the template itself (its fixed wording with made-up values, no AI); or give 1 to 5 example messages it reads, with every value made up: never the person's own messages. TrackerHacker refuses examples holding anything from the person's sheets or mail, addresses other than the sender's or example.com, and templates with a name or account number as fixed text. Works only if the person turned on "Let my assistant share what it builds" in Settings; otherwise tell them where it is.

examples.description: 1 to 5 made-up messages it reads, written like the real ones with other values. Leave out to have TrackerHacker make them up from the template.

name.description: The name everyone sees, like "Chase card alert"; the hack's own name if left out.
